title: alchemilla hybrida var. carniolica
intro: Alchemilla hybrida var. carniolica, commonly known as Alpine Lady's Mantle, is a perennial flowering plant in the buckwheat family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help soothe skin irritations and reduce swelling. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Lady's Mantle include its ability to calm the skin and mucous membranes, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies for skin conditions such as eczema and dermatitis. The bioactive constituents of Alchemilla hybrida var. carniolica include flavonoids, tannins, and mucilages, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
